# Step: fetch all playlists in spotify library (pagination)
spotify_token=globals().get('spotify_token')
print('has_token',bool(spotify_token))

all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # expect list
    print('page',page_index,'type',type(res),'len',len(res) if res else 0)
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    # if less than page_limit, may be last
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        # but still break safely next iteration
        pass
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break

print('total_playlists',len(all_playlists))
# print sample playlist ids/titles
for p in all_playlists[:10]:
    print('pl',p.get('playlist_id'),p.get('title'),'is_public',p.get('is_public'))
# check if duplicate ids
ids=[p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists]
print('unique_playlist_ids',len(set(ids)))

while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('following page',page_index,'len',len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following_artist_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        # likely last page
        pass
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('total_following_artists',len(following_artist_ids))
print('sample_following_ids',sorted(list(following_artist_ids))[:20])

spotify_token=globals()['spotify_token']
unique_song_ids=sorted(list(set(all_song_ids)))
print('unique_song_ids',len(unique_song_ids))

reggae_song_ids=[]
reggae_song_details=[]
reggae_artist_ids=set()

for i,sid in enumerate(unique_song_ids):
    so=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=(so.get('genre') or '').strip()
    genre_lower=genre.lower()
    if genre_lower=='reggae':
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)
        arts=[a['id'] for a in so.get('artists',[])]
        for aid in arts:
            reggae_artist_ids.add(aid)
        reggae_song_details.append({'song_id':sid,'title':so.get('title'),'artists':arts,'genre':so.get('genre')})
    if i<5 or i in [len(unique_song_ids)-1]:
        print('checked',i+1,'sid',sid,'genre',genre)

print('reggae_song_ids_count',len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_artist_ids_count',len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('sample_reggae_songs',reggae_song_details[:10])
